note: Gold answers and accept_patterns are for grading only. build_prompt() sends the reader the rewritten prose and the question text, nothing else.

questions.question: What role does this control play in the pipeline?
questions.gold: It is a gate: each model must pass its own truth control before the relation result is reported.

questions.question: What is the standardized separation T measured in?
questions.gold: Training-projection standard deviations, averaged over eight training partitions.

questions.question: Is the standardized separation an AUROC or a conventional effect size?
Why did the earlier version of this control fail?
questions.gold: The probe was reading the answer token rather than the semantics.

questions.question: Why is the Gemma point drawn as an open marker?
questions.gold: Only its point estimate was retained; no interval is available.
